chunks: He is the Knower of the Unseen and the Seen, the Magnificent, the Most High.

key_terms.الشَّهَادَةِ: The seen realm, or that which is manifest and observable
key_terms.الْغَيْبِ: The unseen realm, including what is hidden from human perception

ai.seo_question: What are the attributes of Allah mentioned in Surar Ar-Ra'd verse 9?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this verse underscores Allah's absolute sovereignty over both the metaphysical realm of the unseen and the physical world of the seen, affirming His transcendence above all limitations. The attributes 'al-Kabir' (The Great) and 'al-Mut'ali' (The Exalted) highlight His majesty and independence, serving as a foundation for understanding divine omniscience in contrast to created beings.
